label: Four mammal forelimb homology model
adaptation_note: Four separately keyed homologous count schematics preserve every selected carrier/ray/phalange count. Explicit categorical encoding replaces anatomical contours and lengths; the original anatomical drawing remains the contour reference.
acceptance_requirement: Preserve every intended bone/ray count and homology. Keep a common scale if claimed; state changed scale otherwise. A count-only schematic is not an anatomical contour drawing.

frames.title: Horse homologous bone sequence
frames.teaching_key: Horse: schematic homologous groups read left to right, proximal to distal. First column is humerus, second one selected radius/reduced-fused-ulna carrier, third is one carpus group (not an individual carpal count). Right-hand rows are metacarpals followed by phalanges; top-to-bottom ray labels III, phalange counts [3]. Two extra short rows above and below the main ray represent vestigial metacarpals II and IV, not complete digits. All glyphs are categorical closed boxes; no anatomical contour, bone-length or common specimen scale is claimed. Source homology and selected ray/segment counts are retained.

frames.title: Whale homologous bone sequence
frames.teaching_key: Whale: schematic homologous groups read left to right, proximal to distal. First column is humerus, second separate radius and ulna carriers, third is one carpus group (not an individual carpal count). Right-hand rows are metacarpals followed by phalanges; top-to-bottom ray labels II, III, IV, V, phalange counts [2, 7, 6, 2].  All glyphs are categorical closed boxes; no anatomical contour, bone-length or common specimen scale is claimed. Source homology and selected ray/segment counts are retained.
